title: Platefull: Sunday meal prep in one screen

product.name: Platefull
product.one_liner: meal-planning app that turns a week of dinners into one grocery list

audience: people 25-40 who cook at home and hate the Sunday grocery run

hook.text: Seven dinners, one grocery list, zero scrolling.
hook.why: Leads with the outcome in the viewer's own words; the app is the explanation.

style: overhead kitchen phone footage, warm afternoon light, hands only

shots.visual: Overhead: a phone slides into frame next to a cutting board, screen shows a 7-day grid filled with dinners
shots.caption:
7 dinners, 1 list, 0 scrolling
AI-generated ad
shots.voiceover: Seven dinners, one grocery list, zero scrolling.

prompt.subject: a hand sliding a phone across a wooden counter next to a cutting board with half an onion
prompt.action: the phone slides to a stop, the screen is lit and shows a weekly grid
prompt.camera: overhead, locked off, phone on a shelf mount
prompt.lighting: warm afternoon window light from the right
prompt.negative: readable fake UI text, logos, extra hands

shots.visual: Hands scrolling a chaotic notes-app list, crossing things out, a receipt with duplicate items
shots.caption: the usual: three apps and a receipt
shots.voiceover: Three apps, a notes list, and a receipt that says you bought garlic twice.

shots.visual: Screen recording: drag three recipes onto the week, tap Build list, the list groups by aisle
shots.caption: drag the week. tap build.
shots.voiceover: Drag your dinners onto the week. Tap build. Everything merges into one list, sorted by aisle.

shots.visual: Overhead: the list on the phone next to the matching groceries laid out on the counter, every line ticked
shots.caption: one trip. every line ticked.
shots.voiceover: One trip, every line ticked, and the garlic only once.

prompt.subject: overhead of a kitchen counter with a phone showing a checked list beside neatly laid out groceries: a head of garlic, lemons, a bunch of parsley, rice, chicken thighs in paper
prompt.action: very slow push in toward the phone, nothing else moves
prompt.negative: readable UI text, brand logos, extra items appearing

shots.visual: Finger taps the app icon on a home screen; store badge comes up
shots.caption: free to start. link below.

claims.evidence: app has a free tier; pricing page checked on the day of filming, keep the date in the campaign notes

notes: No presenter, so there is no persona to disclose; the AI label covers the generated kitchen shots.
Screen recordings are real app footage; do not replace them with generated UI, which would show features that may not exist.
